scope.summary: Persist the dual-driver contract at the OracleConnection boundary without weakening oraclemcp safety policy.
out_of_scope: Publishing or repinning the driver-cx crate family
Adding backend selection configuration or changing the default backend

entry_points.name: OracleConnection backend architecture contract
entry_points.trace: ADR 0002 names driver-cx as the default Cx-native backend, requires separate qualification and explicit selection for Oracle's driver, prohibits automatic cross-driver fallback, defines connection/cancellation/cleanup ownership, preserves fail-closed policy above both backends, and inventories the direct wallet/TNS protocol utility paths.

limitations: Oracle's driver API and runtime contract are not yet available for qualification; bead oraclemcp-driver-cx-oracle-dual-backend-nhteq.3 owns that evidence.
The driver-cx repin remains gated on the renamed 0.9.2 crate family being published and consumer-visible.
